summary: Gain valuable insights and practical knowledge on Human Rights-Based Approaches in humanitarian work with our comprehensive training program.
lede: Human rights-based approaches in humanitarian work help humanitarian teams turn rights commitments into inclusive, accountable response decisions. For professionals involved in assessments, protection decisions, programme delivery, or reporting, the course builds practical skills in rights and protection analysis, participatory needs assessment, and designing feedback and referral processes with confidentiality in mind.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence humanitarian assessments, protection decisions, programme delivery, accountability systems, or donor and leadership reporting. It suits foundation to intermediate practitioners who need a grounded introduction to human rights-based approaches in humanitarian work and a practical way to apply them within existing response structures.
audience: Camp Coordination and Camp Management Officers
modules: Human Rights Foundations for Humanitarian Action
Protection Analysis with Do No Harm
prerequisites: No formal humanitarian certification is required. You should have basic familiarity with humanitarian programmes, community engagement, protection, monitoring, or emergency response. No coding is required. You should bring a laptop if possible, although the exercises can use supplied templates and printed materials. Advanced digital topics, including AI-assisted humanitarian data analysis and Power BI dashboards, are taught at operational application level rather than technical engineering level.
